dessin: A small place card: one landscape flat pale rectangle #FBFCF8 with a 2 px ink outline and sharp square corners. Near the left edge, inside the left quarter of the card only, a dash-dot ink boundary line (long dash, dot, long dash) running from the top edge to the bottom edge with a gentle curve, like the border of a territory. To the right of that boundary, one locality symbol: an ink ring with a solid ink dot at its center, placed at about 30% of the card width from the left, vertically centered. Everything to the right of the locality symbol (the right 60% of the card) is completely empty plain pale paper. No roads, no water, no relief, nothing else.
